our_interpretation: This is a qualified overall assessment of the 2022 essay, with an explicit concession about Deep Research.
'In most other respects' does not require every named point to be established. It also supplies no complete list of respects or rule for weighing them.
The surrounding discussion describes neurosymbolic techniques as useful and increasingly adopted. I do not substitute a requirement to prove their strict necessity.
The relevant comparison runs from the original essay to the February 9, 2025 retrospective. Later advances cannot change what had happened by that post.
Individual empirical propositions could be assessed separately, but their results would not determine this overall judgment without an added weighting rule.
criteria.support_condition: No reproducible overall support condition is supplied. Evidence consistent with the named themes could support parts of the assessment, but cannot establish 'most other respects' without defining and weighing those respects.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No reproducible overall contradiction condition is supplied. A failed prediction or a successful neural system would not alone contradict a judgment that explicitly allows exceptions.
